marks.gloss_en: אלא מאי, דידעי? למה ליה למימר להו? -- if they know, why need he tell them?
לאחזוקי ליה טיבותא למשה -- so that they acknowledge the favour to Moses
(entertained) if it should enter your mind that they do not know
איני?! והא אמר רב פפא: חד אישתעי מילתא בתריה דמר שמואל ונפל קניא מטללא ובזעא לארנקא דמוחיה -- speaking after the dead is not as speaking after a stone
Rav Pappa: one man spoke [ill] after Mar Shmuel, and a reed fell from the roof and split his skull
שאני צורבא מרבנן, דקודשא בריך הוא תבע ביקריה -- a young scholar is different, for the Holy One demands his honour
״שמא״ סלקא דעתך? -- could 'perhaps' enter your mind?
אלא ודאי עשה תשובה -- rather, he certainly repented (the baraita's ruling stands, its reason read as certainty)
if you saw a Torah scholar transgress at night, do not think [ill] after him by day -- perhaps he repented
R' Yitzchak: whoever speaks after the dead is as if he speaks after a stone
whoever speaks after the bier of Torah scholars falls into Gehinnom
דאמר רבי שמעון בן לקיש, וכן תנא משמיה דרבי יוסי: לעולם אל יפתח אדם פיו לשטן -- so one should not say 'You have not exacted one in a thousand'
a person should not say so
מאי קראה? כמעט כסדום היינו... שמעו דבר ה' קציני סדום -- they spoke of themselves as near to Sodom, and the prophet answered them as rulers of Sodom
what is the verse? as it is said: 'we were almost as Sodom' (Isa 1:9); what did the prophet reply to them? 'hear the word of the Lord, rulers of Sodom' (Isa 1:10)
[the baraita's wording:] Master of the worlds, I have sinned much before You, and You have not exacted from me one in a thousand...
״המספר אחר מטתן של תלמידי חכמים״ מאי היא? דתנן... ונדוהו ומת בנדויו
ואמרו לו: מעשה בכרכמית שפחה משוחררת בירושלים והשקוה שמעיה ואבטליון -- a freed maidservant was made to drink
ואמר להם: דוגמא השקוה -- they made her drink [as] a dugma (Steinsaltz: because she was like them, they too being of convert stock)
Akavya ben Mahalalel: one does not give [the sota water] to a convert or to a freed maidservant
״והמזלזל בנטילת ידים״ מאי היא? דתנן... את אלעזר בן חנוך שפקפק בנטילת ידים
R' Yehuda: God forbid that Akavya was ostracized, for the Temple court was not locked upon any man in Israel [equal] in wisdom, purity and fear of sin to Akavya ben Mahalalel
״המגיס דעתו כלפי מעלה״ מאי היא? דתנן, שלח לו שמעון בן שטח לחוני המעגל: צריך אתה להתנדות

Shimon ben Shetach to Choni: you ought to be ostracized, and were you not Choni I would decree ostracism on you; but what shall I do, you nag before God and He does your will, like a son who nags his father -- and of you the verse says 'your father and mother will be glad' (Prov 23:25)
ותו ליכא? והא איכא דתני רב יוסף: תודוס איש רומי... גוזרני עליך נידוי -- are there no more? there is Shimon ben Shetach's threat to Todos

Todos of Rome accustomed the Roman [Jews] to eat roasted whole kids on Passover nights; Shimon ben Shetach sent to him: were you not Todos I would decree ostracism on you, for you feed Israel sacrifices outside
״במשנתנו״ קאמרינן, והא ברייתא היא -- RYbL said 'in our mishna', and this is a baraita
ובמתניתין ליכא? והא איכא הא דתנן: חתכו חוליות... וזהו תנורו של עכנאי -- the oven of Akhnai, over which (ותניא, 19a.16 = p_berachuhu) R' Eliezer was in the end 'blessed'
an oven cut into rings with sand put between ring and ring -- R' Eliezer declares it pure
אפילו הכי, נידוי במתניתין לא תנן -- even so, the ostracism is not taught in the mishna (only in the baraita)
אלא ״בעשרים וארבעה מקומות״ היכא משכחת לה? -- if only three are in the mishna, where do you find twenty-four?
רבי יהושע בן לוי מדמה מילתא למילתא, ורבי אלעזר לא מדמה מילתא למילתא -- RYbL counts cases by likeness, R' Elazar only explicit ones (= p_rybl_medameh, p_elazar_lo_medameh)
R' Yehoshua ben Levi likens one matter to another
in twenty-four places the court ostracizes over the honour of the rabbi, and we learned all of them in our mishna (R' Elazar: where? RYbL: when you look, you will find)
he went out, examined, and found three
what is 'Akhnai' [snake]? it teaches that they surrounded it with halakhot like this snake, and declared it impure
that day they brought all the pure things R' Eliezer had declared pure and burned them before him, and in the end they 'blessed' him
if the returning buriers can begin and finish before reaching the row of comforters, they begin
the mishnah itself means: even one chapter or one verse before reaching the row -- they begin; otherwise not
איני?! והא רב יוסף אפקוהו סמוך לקריאת שמע -- is that so? they took Rav Yosef out close to the Shema!
אדם חשוב שאני -- an important person is different (= p_adam_chashuv_shani)
[the mishnah's clause:] the bearers of the bier and their replacements
